title: 求职与职业发展 · 100 句
description: 岗位选择、简历、投递、面试、录用协商、入职、反馈、转型及离职交接。

items.zh: 职位名称没有说明实际职责。
items.en: The job title does not describe the actual duties.
answers: The job title does not describe the actual duties.
The job title doesn't describe the actual duties.

items.zh: 这个岗位需要经常出差。
items.en: This role involves frequent travel.
answers: This role involves frequent travel.

items.zh: 我想了解团队的工作方式。
items.en: I want to understand how the team operates.
answers: I want to understand how the team operates.

items.zh: 职位说明列出了必要资格。
items.en: The description lists the essential qualifications.
answers: The description lists the essential qualifications.

items.zh: 我具备相关经验，但行业不同。
items.en: My experience is relevant but from another sector.
answers: My experience is relevant but from another sector.

items.zh: 这个职位是新设的吗？
items.en: Is this a newly created position?
answers: Is this a newly created position?

items.zh: 我更看重学习机会。
items.en: Learning opportunities matter more to me.
answers: Learning opportunities matter more to me.

items.zh: 工作地点能灵活安排吗？
items.en: Is there flexibility over the work location?
answers: Is there flexibility over the work location?

items.zh: 这份工作需要周末值班。
items.en: This job includes weekend duties.
answers: This job includes weekend duties.

items.zh: 我想知道招聘的原因。
items.en: I would like to know why you are recruiting.
answers: I would like to know why you are recruiting.

items.zh: 我把最近的经历放在最前面。
items.en: I put my most recent experience first.
answers: I put my most recent experience first.

items.zh: 这段描述缺少具体成果。
items.en: This description lacks concrete achievements.
answers: This description lacks concrete achievements.

items.zh: 我需要解释这段职业空档。
items.en: I need to explain this career break.
answers: I need to explain this career break.

items.zh: 项目规模可以体现责任大小。
items.en: Project scale can show the level of responsibility.
answers: Project scale can show the level of responsibility.

items.zh: 别把职责和成果混为一谈。
items.en: Do not confuse responsibilities with results.
answers: Do not confuse responsibilities with results.
Don't confuse responsibilities with results.

items.zh: 我删掉了过时的软件技能。
items.en: I removed outdated software skills.
answers: I removed outdated software skills.

items.zh: 这项经历值得放进求职信。
items.en: This experience belongs in the covering letter.
answers: This experience belongs in the covering letter.

items.zh: 推荐人同意被联系了吗？
items.en: Has the referee agreed to be contacted?
answers: Has the referee agreed to be contacted?

items.zh: 作品链接现在打不开。
items.en: The portfolio link is currently inaccessible.
answers: The portfolio link is currently inaccessible.

items.zh: 我需要让日期格式一致。
items.en: I need consistent date formatting.
answers: I need consistent date formatting.

items.zh: 申请系统限制了字数。
items.en: The application system imposes a word limit.
answers: The application system imposes a word limit.

items.zh: 附件上传后预览不正常。
items.en: The attachment preview is incorrect after uploading.
answers: The attachment preview is incorrect after uploading.

items.zh: 我提交前保存了一份副本。
items.en: I saved a copy before submission.
answers: I saved a copy before submission.

items.zh: 截止日期是否包含当天？
items.en: Does the deadline include that day?
answers: Does the deadline include that day?

items.zh: 我收到了自动回执。
items.en: I received an automated acknowledgement.
answers: I received an automated acknowledgement.

items.zh: 还需要补充工作证明吗？
items.en: Is further proof of employment required?
answers: Is further proof of employment required?

items.zh: 我不想同时提交重复申请。
items.en: I do not want to submit duplicate applications.
answers: I do not want to submit duplicate applications.
I don't want to submit duplicate applications.

items.zh: 我想更新已提交的联系方式。
items.en: I want to update my submitted contact details.
answers: I want to update my submitted contact details.

items.zh: 这封信需要写给谁？
items.en: To whom should this letter be addressed?
answers: To whom should this letter be addressed?

items.zh: 我已明确注明可到岗时间。
items.en: I clearly stated when I could start.
answers: I clearly stated when I could start.

items.zh: 我准备了三个相关案例。
items.en: I prepared three relevant examples.
answers: I prepared three relevant examples.

items.zh: 我不想背诵整段回答。
items.en: I do not want to recite entire answers.
answers: I do not want to recite entire answers.
I don't want to recite entire answers.

items.zh: 这次面试包含现场任务吗？
items.en: Does this interview include a practical task?
answers: Does this interview include a practical task?

items.zh: 我需要确认面试时区。
items.en: I need to confirm the interview time zone.
answers: I need to confirm the interview time zone.

items.zh: 设备测试安排在面试前半小时。
items.en: The equipment check is scheduled for half an hour before the interview.
answers: The equipment check is scheduled for half an hour before the interview.
items.notes: be scheduled for：安排在；before 给出比较基准。

items.zh: 我想练习简洁地介绍自己。
items.en: I want to practise introducing myself concisely.
answers: I want to practise introducing myself concisely.

items.zh: 公司的主要客户是谁？
items.en: Who are the company's main clients?
answers: Who are the company's main clients?

items.zh: 我查阅了最近发布的报告。
items.en: I reviewed the recently published report.
answers: I reviewed the recently published report.

items.zh: 我需要准备关于团队的问题。
items.en: I need questions about the team.
answers: I need questions about the team.

items.zh: 这项任务允许使用参考资料吗？
items.en: Are reference materials permitted for this task?
answers: Are reference materials permitted for this task?

items.zh: 我能用一个项目来说明。
items.en: I can illustrate that with a project.
answers: I can illustrate that with a project.

items.zh: 当时我的职责是协调交付。
items.en: My responsibility was to coordinate delivery.
answers: My responsibility was to coordinate delivery.

items.zh: 我们最初低估了工作量。
items.en: We initially underestimated the workload.
answers: We initially underestimated the workload.

items.zh: 我先核实事实，再提出方案。
items.en: I checked the facts before proposing a solution.
answers: I checked the facts before proposing a solution.

items.zh: 这个成果是团队共同取得的。
items.en: This result was a collective achievement.
answers: This result was a collective achievement.

items.zh: 我不会把它完全归功于自己。
items.en: I would not take sole credit for it.
answers: I would not take sole credit for it.
I wouldn't take sole credit for it.

items.zh: 这次经历改变了我的做法。
items.en: That experience changed my approach.
answers: That experience changed my approach.

items.zh: 我还没有直接管理预算的经验。
items.en: I have not managed a budget directly yet.
answers: I have not managed a budget directly yet.
I haven't managed a budget directly yet.

items.zh: 不过，我参与过成本估算。
items.en: I have, however, contributed to cost estimates.
answers: I have, however, contributed to cost estimates.

items.zh: 我可以说明自己如何学习新工具。
items.en: I can explain how I learn unfamiliar tools.
answers: I can explain how I learn unfamiliar tools.

items.zh: 录用通知是有条件的吗？
items.en: Is the offer conditional?
answers: Is the offer conditional?

items.zh: 试用期多长？
items.en: How long is the probation period?
answers: How long is the probation period?

items.zh: 薪资范围是否包含奖金？
items.en: Does the salary range include bonuses?
answers: Does the salary range include bonuses?

items.zh: 薪资调整评审与绩效考核是分开进行的吗？
items.en: Are salary reviews separate from performance appraisals?
answers: Are salary reviews separate from performance appraisals?
items.notes: salary review：薪资评审；performance appraisal：绩效考核。

items.zh: 这项福利从入职就开始吗？
items.en: Does this benefit begin on joining?
answers: Does this benefit begin on joining?

items.zh: 能把约定写进录用信吗？
items.en: Could the agreement be included in the offer letter?
answers: Could the agreement be included in the offer letter?

items.zh: 我需要时间仔细阅读合同。
items.en: I need time to read the contract carefully.
answers: I need time to read the contract carefully.

items.zh: 我能在周一前回复吗？
items.en: May I respond by Monday?
answers: May I respond by Monday?

items.zh: 通知期会影响入职日期。
items.en: My notice period affects my starting date.
answers: My notice period affects my starting date.

items.zh: 我感谢邀请，但决定婉拒。
items.en: I appreciate the offer but have decided to decline.
answers: I appreciate the offer but have decided to decline.

items.zh: 第一天应该向谁报到？
items.en: Whom should I report to on my first day?
answers: Whom should I report to on my first day?

items.zh: 访问权限还没开通。
items.en: My access has not been activated.
answers: My access has not been activated.
My access hasn't been activated.

items.zh: 我需要一份团队联系人名单。
items.en: I need a list of team contacts.
answers: I need a list of team contacts.

items.zh: 有没有交接文档可以先看？
items.en: Is there a handover document I can read?
answers: Is there a handover document I can read?

items.zh: 这个缩写在团队里是什么意思？
items.en: What does this abbreviation mean within the team?
answers: What does this abbreviation mean within the team?

items.zh: 入职第一周，我的哪些任务应该优先处理？
items.en: Which of my tasks should take precedence during the first week?
answers: Which of my tasks should take precedence during the first week?
items.notes: take precedence：优先；询问入职初期的任务排序。

items.zh: 这项任务有完成示例吗？
items.en: Is there a completed example of this task?
answers: Is there a completed example of this task?

items.zh: 我会记录需要跟进的问题。
items.en: I will log questions for follow-up.
answers: I will log questions for follow-up.

items.zh: 谁能帮助我熟悉流程？
items.en: Who can help me learn the workflow?
answers: Who can help me learn the workflow?

items.zh: 我需要确认汇报关系。
items.en: I need clarity on reporting lines.
answers: I need clarity on reporting lines.

items.zh: 我想知道哪项能力最需要加强。
items.en: I want to know which skill needs most improvement.
answers: I want to know which skill needs most improvement.

items.zh: 能指出最近哪项任务反映出我的优先级判断有欠缺吗？
items.en: Could you point to a recent task where my prioritisation fell short?
answers: Could you point to a recent task where my prioritisation fell short?
items.notes: point to：举出；fall short：未达到要求。

items.zh: 我愿意承担更复杂的任务。
items.en: I am ready for more complex assignments.
answers: I am ready for more complex assignments.

items.zh: 我需要定期收到反馈。
items.en: I need feedback at regular intervals.
answers: I need feedback at regular intervals.

items.zh: 这个目标是否可以衡量？
items.en: Is this objective measurable?
answers: Is this objective measurable?

items.zh: 我想观察资深同事如何处理。
items.en: I want to observe an experienced colleague handling it.
answers: I want to observe an experienced colleague handling it.

items.zh: 我的工作范围已经扩大了。
items.en: The scope of my role has expanded.
answers: The scope of my role has expanded.

items.zh: 我们能约定一次进度回顾吗？
items.en: Could we schedule a progress review?
answers: Could we schedule a progress review?

items.zh: 这份评价批评了一种方法，而那种方法正是经理之前要求我采用的。
items.en: The assessment criticises a method that my manager previously asked me to use.
answers: The assessment criticises a method that my manager previously asked me to use.
items.notes: that 引导定语从句，具体解释评价与早先要求的冲突。

items.zh: 我希望区分表现问题与资源不足。
items.en: I want to separate performance issues from resource gaps.
answers: I want to separate performance issues from resource gaps.

items.zh: 我想把现有技能用于新领域。
items.en: I want to transfer my skills to a new field.
answers: I want to transfer my skills to a new field.

items.zh: 转行并不意味着过去的经验失去了价值。
items.en: Changing careers does not make past experience worthless.
answers: Changing careers does not make past experience worthless.
Changing careers doesn't make past experience worthless.

items.zh: 我需要了解这个行业的入门路径。
items.en: I need to understand entry routes into this industry.
answers: I need to understand entry routes into this industry.

items.zh: 兼职课程更适合我的安排。
items.en: A part-time course fits my schedule better.
answers: A part-time course fits my schedule better.

items.zh: 自由职业工作可以让我在决定转行之前，先检验市场对我技能的需求。
items.en: Freelance work would let me test demand for my skills before committing to a career change.
answers: Freelance work would let me test demand for my skills before committing to a career change.
items.notes: test demand：检验需求；commit to：决定投入。

items.zh: 这项证书需要定期更新吗？
items.en: Does this certification require periodic renewal?
answers: Does this certification require periodic renewal?

items.zh: 我不能只看起薪。
items.en: I cannot judge by starting salary alone.
answers: I cannot judge by starting salary alone.
I can't judge by starting salary alone.

items.zh: 职业发展并不总是直线上升。
items.en: Career development is not always a straight climb.
answers: Career development is not always a straight climb.
Career development isn't always a straight climb.

items.zh: 我希望保留跨行业选择。
items.en: I want to keep options across industries open.
answers: I want to keep options across industries open.

items.zh: 我会根据新信息调整计划。
items.en: I will revise my plan as new information emerges.
answers: I will revise my plan as new information emerges.

items.zh: 我会列出所有未完成事项。
items.en: I will list all outstanding matters.
answers: I will list all outstanding matters.

items.zh: 交接需要说明决定的背景。
items.en: The handover needs context for previous decisions.
answers: The handover needs context for previous decisions.

items.zh: 不要只把文件发过去就结束。
items.en: Do more than simply send the files.
answers: Do more than simply send the files.

items.zh: 我已安排接替者参加客户会议。
items.en: I have arranged for my successor to attend the client meeting.
answers: I have arranged for my successor to attend the client meeting.
items.notes: arrange for someone to do：安排某人做某事。

items.zh: 最后一周适合集中回答问题。
items.en: The final week is useful for answering questions.
answers: The final week is useful for answering questions.

items.zh: 这份记录包含重要的截止日期。
items.en: This record contains key deadlines.
answers: This record contains key deadlines.

items.zh: 我会归还公司提供的设备。
items.en: I will return the company-issued equipment.
answers: I will return the company-issued equipment.

items.zh: 客户需要知道今后联系谁。
items.en: Clients need to know their future contact.
answers: Clients need to know their future contact.

items.zh: 我想以专业的方式结束合作。
items.en: I want to conclude the relationship professionally.
answers: I want to conclude the relationship professionally.

items.zh: 请确认交接材料已经收到。
items.en: Please acknowledge receipt of the handover materials.
answers: Please acknowledge receipt of the handover materials.
